capabilities: Split long text cards into new cards by delimiter, blank lines, or heading level
Merge and sort selected cards via a Preview/Sort/Find & Replace workspace
Add, edit, and batch-remove numeric badges used for number sorting
Find and replace text across canvas cards with regex and case sensitivity
Auto-fit card heights, arrange cards and groups, and export cards as PNG images
extras: Full documentation lives in a separate docs/ folder rather than the README; UI supports English and Simplified Chinese and follows the Obsidian language setting. README states no accounts, paid services, telemetry, or network access.
intentEvidence: Canvas Loom is an Obsidian Canvas plugin for splitting, sorting, merging, previewing, and cleaning up Canvas text cards.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in tools for restructuring card text, ordering cards by content or position, or tidying card layouts, so multi-card workflows must be done by hand.

relations.evidence: Early development referenced joshuakto's open-source project obsidian-cardify.

summary: Canvas toolkit that splits, merges, sorts, badges, finds-and-replaces, and cleans up the layout of text cards without leaving Canvas.
